assessments.reasoning: The NIST official legacy archive hosts the NBS publication. Its title and foreword identify the committee materials and their original approved release dates. The captured complete source exactly matches the registered digest ed60a71b77cb98a49267334b38fc334a7fcf4365dd593a8e467ac83ba363b780. The identified controlling passage is Part I (MDC/28), §1.2.4 Data Types, printed page 1-3 / PDF page 17. The MUMPS narrative specification treats arithmetic inputs as strings interpreted numerically under a uniform rule and treats the numeric result as a special case of strings. The language specification expressly permits an implementation to use multiple internal representations. The clause distinguishes general numeric values, integers, and truth values. An abstract string representation does not require internally storing all values as strings.
